title: Divisions in the Church, Jesus Christ the Foundation

questions.question: Paul says he could not address the Corinthians as spiritual people, but as people of the flesh, as ____ in Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:1 (ESV): "But I, brothers, could not address you as spiritual people, but as people of the flesh, as infants in Christ."

questions.question: What did Paul feed the Corinthians with because they were not ready for solid food?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:2 (ESV): "I fed you with milk, not solid food, for you were not ready for it. And even now you are not yet ready,"

questions.question: Paul says they are still of the flesh because there is ____ among them.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:3 (ESV): "for you are still of the flesh. For while there is jealousy and strife among you, are you not of the flesh and behaving only in a human way?"

questions.question: When one says, "I follow Paul," and another, "I follow Apollos," what does Paul say they are being?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:4 (ESV): "For when one says, 'I follow Paul,' and another, 'I follow Apollos,' are you not being merely human?"

questions.question: What then is Apollos? What is Paul? Servants through whom you believed, as the Lord assigned to each. Paul says he planted, Apollos watered, but who gave the growth?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:6 (ESV): "I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the growth."

questions.question: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God who ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:7 (ESV): "So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God who gives the growth."

questions.question: He who plants and he who waters are one, and each will receive his ____ according to his labor.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:8 (ESV): "He who plants and he who waters are one, and each will receive his wages according to his labor."

questions.question: For we are God's fellow workers. You are God's field, God's ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:9 (ESV): "For we are God's fellow workers. You are God's field, God's building."

questions.question: According to the grace of God given to him, Paul laid what as a skilled master builder?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:10 (ESV): "According to the grace of God given to me, like a skilled master builder I laid a foundation, and someone else is building upon it. Let each one take care how he builds upon it."

questions.question: For no one can lay a foundation other than that which is laid, which is ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:11 (ESV): "For no one can lay a foundation other than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ."

questions.question: What materials does Paul list that someone might use to build on the foundation?
options: Gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:12 (ESV): "Now if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw—"

questions.question: Each one's work will become manifest, for the Day will disclose it, because it will be revealed by ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:13 (ESV): "each one's work will become manifest, for the Day will disclose it, because it will be revealed by fire, and the fire will test what sort of work each one has done."

questions.question: If the work that anyone has built on the foundation survives, he will receive a reward. If anyone's work is burned up, he will suffer loss, though he himself will be saved, but only as through ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:14-15 (ESV): "If the work that anyone has built on the foundation survives, he will receive a reward. If anyone's work is burned up, he will suffer loss, though he himself will be saved, but only as through fire."

questions.question: Do you not know that you are God's ____ and that God's Spirit dwells in you?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:16 (ESV): "Do you not know that you are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells in you?"

questions.question: If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy him. For God's temple is ____, and you are that temple.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 3:17 (ESV): "If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy him. For God's temple is holy, and you are that temple."

key_verse_text: Do you not know that you are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells in you?
